why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Install the app from the App Store or Google Play, using the links on thepitapp.xyz . It is free.

Create an account with an email code, Apple, Google or Discord. The app creates your wallet at this point. Warning The wallet isn't private. The privacy policy says: "Your EVM wallet address is disclosed publicly." It is attached to your public profile.
Follow traders and post your own calls. You can share a referral code, though The Pit hasn't said what a referral earns.
Follow @ThePitApp on X for any reward announcement.
costs: Downloading the app and creating an account cost nothing. The Pit hasn't published trading fees, a minimum deposit or withdrawal fees anywhere we could find, so the real cost of trading through it is unknown.
risks: You must be at least 18. The terms add that The Pit "is not available in all jurisdictions", and no country list is published. There is no identity check. The privacy policy says "we do not perform identity verification". The results other traders show are self-reported. The terms say The Pit "does not verify them against blockchain records or any other source before publishing them". No security
